vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." Company makes the road shorter.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.

"Hey." A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek.)
📓 Journal: the man in his 30s, with a scarred cheek taught the woman in her 30s The Forager’s Eye.
👀 When the others traded stories about Denver, the man in his 30s, with a scarred cheek went quiet in a way that wasn't listening — more like realizing they had nothing true to trade.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek).
A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇪🇸 Spanish. You share no language at all.
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Quiet birds. I'll add it to the list of things that mean something."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek paces the hall, restless, then sits. Then paces.
📓 Journal: the man in his 30s, with a scarred cheek taught the person in their 30s The Forager’s Eye.
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Something's been at the pantry. Not an animal — the jars were moved, not broken."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
🛡️ Minh, Deborah, Milton and Francisco met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Minh, Deborah, Milton, Francisco are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Minh, Deborah, Milton, Gustavo and Jesse met them at the door — 5 put down. Minh, Deborah, Milton, Gustavo, Jesse are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dale just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Milton just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mara just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
